aboutMauritius.title: Discover Mauritius by Road
aboutMauritius.paragraph1: Mauritius is an island of contrasts — powder-white beaches along the lagoon, dramatic mountain peaks inland, and coastal roads that connect them all. Renting a car in Mauritius is the easiest way to explore at your own pace, from the buzzing markets of Port Louis to the quiet shores of Le Morne.
aboutMauritius.paragraph2: With car rental Mauritius options available for pickup right at SSR International Airport, your holiday starts the moment you land. Self-driving gives you the freedom to reach popular attractions — waterfalls, botanical gardens, viewpoints and hidden beaches — on your own schedule, without waiting on tours or transfers.
aboutMauritius.paragraph3: Driving in Mauritius is straightforward for visitors: roads are well maintained, distances are short, and our team is on hand with local tips for the best routes, scenic drives and seasonal attractions. Whether it's a short holiday or an extended stay, a rental car turns Mauritius tourism into a personal road trip.

about.kicker: Over a Decade of Trusted Service
about.title: About Codexia
about.intro1: At Codexia, we believe that every memorable journey begins with complete peace of mind.
about.intro2: For more than a decade, we have been providing visitors to Mauritius with reliable, comfortable, and well-maintained rental vehicles backed by exceptional customer care. Since our founding, our focus has remained unchanged: delivering a seamless experience from the moment you book until the day you return your vehicle.
about.intro3: As a locally established company, we understand what travelers need — convenience, flexibility, transparency, and dependable support throughout their stay. Whether you're here for a relaxing holiday, a business trip, or an island adventure, our team is committed to helping you explore Mauritius with confidence.
about.intro4: Our continued growth over the past ten years has been built on the trust and satisfaction of our customers. As we look ahead, we remain dedicated to expanding our fleet, enhancing our services, and creating memorable experiences for every visitor who chooses Codexia.
about.missionText1: Our mission is to provide an outstanding car rental experience that combines reliability, convenience, and genuine Mauritian hospitality.
about.missionText2: We are committed to delivering quality vehicles, transparent service, and personalized customer support, allowing every visitor to explore Mauritius safely, comfortably, and with complete confidence. By putting our customers at the heart of everything we do, we aim to build lasting relationships while continuously growing our fleet and raising the standard of service in the industry.

airportRental.title: Airport Rental
airportRental.text: Free delivery and recovery at SSR Airport, with flight tracking for delayed arrivals.
airportRental.metaDescription: Rent a car at SSR International Airport in Mauritius with free delivery, flight tracking for delayed arrivals, and a vehicle ready the moment you land.
airportRental.intro: Landing in Mauritius and heading straight to your hotel is far easier with your rental car already waiting. We deliver to SSR International Airport at no extra charge and track your flight, so a delayed arrival never means a missed pickup or an idle vehicle.
airportRental.highlight1Text: No delivery fee at SSR Airport, in either direction — pickup on arrival, drop-off before departure.
airportRental.highlight2Text: We monitor your flight number and adjust your handover time automatically if it's delayed.
airportRental.highlight3Text: Paperwork and a quick vehicle walkthrough take minutes, so you're on the road shortly after clearing customs.
airportRental.closing: Not sure which vehicle suits your trip? See our Mauritius Car Rental overview for the full fleet, or check our Airport Guide for what to expect after you land.

mauritius.title: Mauritius Car Rental
mauritius.metaDescription: Rent a car in Mauritius with Codexia — unlimited mileage, comprehensive insurance and free airport delivery. Compare our fleet and book online in minutes.
mauritius.intro: Codexia has been renting cars across Mauritius for over 10 years, from Grand Baie in the north to Le Morne in the south. Whether you're touring the coast, driving to Port Louis for business, or exploring inland towns, our fleet and local support are built around how people actually get around the island.
mauritius.highlight1Text: Pick up and drop off across Mauritius, with free delivery and collection at SSR International Airport.
mauritius.highlight2Text: Unlimited mileage and comprehensive insurance are included in every rental, so your quote is your final price.
mauritius.highlight3Text: Our team knows Mauritius's roads, driving conventions and peak-season demand, and is available 24/7 if you need help.
mauritius.closing: Most visitors renting a car in Mauritius are driving on the left for the first time and need a vehicle within a day of landing — our Airport Car Rental page covers pickup logistics in detail, and our Driving Guide explains local road rules before you set off.
mauritius.emptyVehicles: Our full fleet listing is being updated.

suv.title: SUV Rental in Mauritius
suv.metaDescription: Rent an SUV in Mauritius for extra space, higher ground clearance and comfortable long-distance drives. Free airport delivery, unlimited mileage, comprehensive insurance.
suv.intro: An SUV gives you more room for luggage, better visibility on winding coastal roads, and confident handling on the odd unpaved stretch near hotels and villas — a popular choice for groups, golf trips and longer island tours.
suv.highlight1Text: Extra boot capacity for luggage, golf bags or diving gear, plus room to stretch out on longer drives.
suv.highlight2Text: Higher ground clearance handles speed bumps and uneven driveways common at resorts and guesthouses.
suv.highlight3Text: Unlimited mileage, comprehensive insurance and free airport delivery apply to SUVs just like the rest of our fleet.
suv.closing: SUV availability varies with the season — check our SUV listings below, or browse the full fleet if you're flexible on model.

automatic.title: Automatic Car Rental in Mauritius
automatic.metaDescription: Rent an automatic car in Mauritius — no clutch, no stress, just easy driving on the left. Unlimited mileage and comprehensive insurance included.
automatic.intro: Driving on the left is unfamiliar enough for most visitors without also managing a manual gearbox — an automatic transmission lets you focus on the road, roundabouts and local driving habits instead of shifting gears.
automatic.highlight1Text: One less thing to think about when adjusting to left-hand driving and unfamiliar junctions.
automatic.highlight2Text: Automatics make stop-start traffic around Port Louis and coastal towns noticeably less tiring.
automatic.highlight3Text: Every automatic in our fleet comes with unlimited mileage, comprehensive insurance and free airport delivery.
automatic.closing: Automatic vehicles are in higher demand during peak season — book early if your travel dates are fixed.
automatic.emptyVehicles: No automatic vehicles are currently listed.

family.title: Family Car Rental in Mauritius
family.metaDescription: Rent a family car in Mauritius with enough seats and boot space for the whole trip. Child seats available on request, unlimited mileage, comprehensive insurance.
family.intro: Travelling with children means more luggage, more stops, and less patience for a cramped back seat — our family-sized vehicles are chosen for comfortable seating and enough boot space for prams, cases and beach gear.
family.highlight1Text: Five-seat vehicles with genuine boot space for family luggage, not just an overnight bag.
family.highlight2Text: Let us know your children's ages when booking and we'll arrange an appropriate child or booster seat.
family.highlight3Text: Skip the rental-counter queue with young children in tow — we deliver to SSR Airport at no extra charge.
family.closing: Planning a longer family holiday? See our Long-Term Rental page for weekly and monthly rates.
family.emptyVehicles: No family vehicles are currently listed.

longTerm.title: Long-Term Car Rental in Mauritius
longTerm.metaDescription: Weekly and monthly car rental in Mauritius for extended stays, remote work trips or long-term relocation. Better rates than daily bookings, same full insurance.
longTerm.intro: Staying in Mauritius for a few weeks or longer? Renting by the week or month works out considerably cheaper than a string of daily bookings, with the same unlimited mileage and comprehensive insurance included throughout your stay.
longTerm.highlight1Text: Extended rentals are priced lower per day than short bookings — ask for a quote based on your exact dates.
longTerm.highlight2Text: Set your dates once and keep the same vehicle for the length of your stay, instead of re-booking every few days.
longTerm.highlight3Text: Comprehensive insurance and unlimited mileage apply for the whole rental period, however long it runs.
longTerm.closing: Long-term rentals are subject to availability — contact us with your dates and we'll confirm the best vehicle and rate for your stay.
longTerm.emptyVehicles: No long-term vehicles are currently listed.
